description: This file defines an API client module using axios for HTTP requests, including dynamic base URL configuration, token management, and request/response interceptors.

methods.name: getBaseUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the base URL for API requests, considering runtime config, environment variables, or default fallback.

methods.name: setAuthTokens
methods.description: Sets the authentication tokens used for authorized API requests.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the specified API path with optional query parameters.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs a POST request to the specified API path with provided data.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Performs a PATCH request to the specified API path with provided data.

methods.name: del
methods.description: Performs a DELETE request to the specified API path.
